name: Cosan Group
desc:
Medical Assistant Patient Care Coordinator | $16.33 to $24.00/hr depending on state | Outbound Patient Calls, Health Coaching, No Sales Expected
Company: Cosan Group
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
You work from home and manage a panel of 400 to 450 patients, many with chronic conditions. Each day you make 50 to 60 outbound calls to check in, support their care plans, and coach them on their health. You work with providers, clinical teams, and caregivers to meet patient needs, and you document every call in real time in the care coordination platform. The work includes Chronic Care Management, Behavioral Health Integration, and Remote Physiological Monitoring services. You also stay on schedule with monthly outreach goals and follow HIPAA rules in every call and note.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and rapport building
- Active listening
- Patient advocacy
- Time management
- Attention to detail
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment. Candidates also complete a company-provided internet speed test to confirm 50 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Nationally recognized medical assistant certification (CMA, RMA, CCMA, NCMA, CMAC, or state-issued MA-C) OR Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT). This is required before applying.
Required Experience: At least 1 year of clinical experience in primary care, a hospital, or a specialty healthcare setting. Experience with Electronic Medical Records (EMRs).
Preferred Experience: Care coordination, chronic care management, or behavioral health integration. Remote patient monitoring platforms. Managing large patient panels (200+). Bilingual English and Spanish is preferred.

Required Skills:
- Strong phone communication and rapport building
- EMR use and strong computer skills
- Comfortable with several technology platforms
- HIPAA-compliant private home office
- Internet of at least 50 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload
- Legally authorized to work in the United States

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Already holds a medical assistant certification or CPhT
- Wants to move from in-person clinical work to fully remote
- Enjoys building long-term relationships with the same patients
- Is comfortable making 50 to 60 calls a day and documenting as they go

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Does not have an active MA certification or CPhT (hard requirement)
- Has less than 1 year of clinical experience
- Prefers one-time customer service calls over ongoing patient relationships
- Does not have a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email or one at the end of the application
3. Watch for an email or text inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening goes, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Medical assistant certification
- Chronic care management
- Care coordination
- Health coaching
- Electronic medical records (EMR)
- HIPAA compliance
- Behavioral health integration
- Remote patient monitoring
- Patient advocacy
- Clinical documentation

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell me about your medical assistant certification and how you have used it in a clinical setting.
- How do you build rapport with a patient over the phone when you can't be in the room?
- Tell us about a time you managed a large caseload or patient panel and kept your documentation accurate. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time a patient pushed back on following a care plan. What happened, how did you handle it, and how did it turn out?
- What experience do you have with chronic care management, behavioral health integration, or remote patient monitoring?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $16.33 to $24.00/hr depending on state. Tier 1 states $16.33 to $20.00, Tier 2 states $18.50 to $23.50, Tier 3 states $22.00 to $24.00. Offers are based on work location, skills, experience, and certifications.
-Shift: Monday through Friday, 100% work from home, no weekends or late nights.
-Benefits: Paid time off plus company holidays, medical, dental, and vision insurance, complimentary life insurance, 401(k) plan, optional short-term and long-term disability, critical illness and accident coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program with mental health resources.
-Equipment Provided: Yes, company-provided laptop, monitor, headset, and more.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: A medical assistant certification (CMA, RMA, CCMA, NCMA, CMAC, or state MA-C) or CPhT is required before applying, and so is 1 year of clinical experience, so only refer participants who already have both. Applicants must complete a company speed test showing 50 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload. The role needs a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace. WRO coworking spaces are HIPAA compliant (private offices with closed doors), so talk to your coach. Camera requirements and training length are not listed. Oklahoma is one of the states this role is open to.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Care Coordinator → Senior Care Coordinator → Care Coordination Team Lead → Clinical Program Supervisor → Care Coordination Program Manager. This role builds patient outreach, health coaching, chronic care management, and EMR documentation skills.
